2.69.9 Table.Label
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Label element specifies a document map label to identify a Table within the rendered
report. This element is optional.
If the Table.Label element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or
an expression that evaluates to a Variant. If the expression returns NULL, no item is added to the
document map. This element is ignored if the table is contained within a page header or page footer.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Label element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Label element.
 <xsd:element name="Label" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
